name: ztpf_author_template_like_loopback_vlan
why: Generate a new template by example. From the engineer's history: "Use an existing template to find the next loopback but create this script to find the next vlan interface to use."

A template only sees the data its linked metadata sources collect, so the new one must link the VLAN source (DeviceDB System Interfaces - VLAN), not the loopback one. The source template is untouched.

Every VLAN the device already has sits on a parent port (the VLAN source's real output shows `interface`), and FortiOS rejects a VLAN without one: the new template must `set interface`. Early runs copied the loopback shape and left it out.

steps.user: Use this template as an example and make a new template called Create Next VLAN Interface that finds the next free VLAN id on the device and creates that VLAN interface.
